limitations: Calendar and Futures exports are independent snapshots with no common acquisition time or freshness guarantee.
Retained futures metadata is not guaranteed to have been known on the historical trade date.
Read-only queries require separately prepared complete caches; they never ensure or repair missing data.
Close relationships are descriptive, not executable roll quotes, forecasts or investment recommendations.
Fees, slippage, margin, financing, dividends, future changes and waiting value are excluded.
